hints: Keep front and size instead of front and rear. size makes empty and full trivially distinguishable, which front == rear alone cannot do.
The slot to write into is (front + size) % CAP. Derive it: front is where element 0 sits, so element number 'size' sits size steps later, modulo CAP.
dequeue advances front with q->front = (q->front + 1) % CAP and decrements size. The value in the vacated slot does not need clearing.
source: Rebuilt from NITC_Lab_S2 Lab9 P5 (circular student queue)
title: Circular queue: reuse the stranded slots
